notes: Maternity clinic intake note. Also carries vital signs, lab results, the patient's own wishes, an alert and a plan of care (context only; the alert is not a problem). Hypertension I10 and epilepsy G40 fall under the maternity checklist; a past thrombosis (I80) is the 'veritulppa' option. Folic acid, vitamin D and calcium answer three supplement questions. Enalapril is a stopped medication. The caesarean section is a procedure and the miscarriage is history, so neither is a problem. HETU only, so birth_date is null (D-10). 'Ei tiedossa olevia allergioita' is an unscoped none-known statement (scope all).
